tier1_family_master: cutoff_ns = start_recv_ns - 1 ns (strict decision boundary; the Oct 18 ledger's own rule, 749 of 749)
ref_recv_ns (receive clock of the last group known by the cutoff: the reference midpoint and touch)
outcomes at start + h for h in 1, 5, 20, 60, 120, 300, 600 s from the last group known by then; grp_<h>s = -1 and chg NaN where the horizon passes the 21:00 UTC close
order-level windows end at cutoff (start - 1 ns) over the previous 1, 5, 20, 60 s; NaN where the window begins before the date member
clocks.tier1_pin_ledgers: every record carries start, cutoff and reference-group clocks as ns and UTC; pins carry known_by_cutoff_ns, known_by_receive_ns (reference group) or outcome_window_start_plus_<h>s
clocks.tier2_tables: per UTC member; decisions every 3 s with features as of the cutoff and outcomes after it (c12); one-second series by receive second (c16, c17); closed-market rows and seconds left out (odcfg.closed_mask); the cross-day tables are aggregates with no clock of their own
clocks.session_scope: session groups = prior member from 21:00 UTC to the date member's 21:00 UTC close; Oct 2 and Oct 17 are partial from the UTC snapshot (their family indexes begin at 00:00 UTC), Oct 3 and Oct 18 full sessions

time_sensitive_new_files.aggregates_without_clock: crossday/t2x_*.csv, crossday/t1x_*.csv, crossday/pairs_full/*.csv, tables/<session>/t1_cells*, t1_stack_variants, t1_corners*, t1_oriented*, t1_refill*, t1_fourarm* (summaries over the pinned rows; not pinned)

limitations: Each day is one session of one instrument; nothing is pooled across days; counts of days are counts.
The Tier 2 cross-day reference distribution is 20 shifted-Y draws per day combined day by day; the regime comparison used the same count.
Pair couplings beyond the line are rare by construction (family-wise line over 40 shifts on every third pair, as c15 defined it).

Tier 1 order-level windows exist only for families inside the date member with a full window; the 60 s aggressor-lot reconciliation to the retained ROOT operands is 744/752, 749/742, 770/774, 654/656 of 781, 796, 809, 694 (the rest differ by the unknown-side lots the retained operands count differently; not examined further).
The session groups come from the rebuilt tapes, not the retained exports; on Oct 18 they reproduce the export-based tables exactly (583,688 groups).
Oct 2 and Oct 17 family indexes begin at the UTC snapshot; the prior evening of those sessions is in the group arrays (from the prefix members) but no family start of theirs falls in it.
No trade cost, fee, slippage or execution assumption anywhere; these are discovery readouts on already-studied days, not out-of-sample validation.
